def make_counter(start):
    value = start
    def inc():
        nonlocal value
        next_value = value + 1
        value = next_value
        return value
    def read():
        return value
    return [inc, read]

log = []
class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.current = 0
    def __iter__(self):
        return self
    def __next__(self):
        done_now = self.current >= 2
        if not done_now:
            value = self.current
            self.current = self.current + 1
            return value
        raise StopIteration
it = Counter()
log.append("same" if iter(it) is it else "different")
log.append(next(it))
log.append(next(it))
log.append(next(it, "done"))
print(log)
